title: FedDPGAN: Federated Differentially Private Generative Adversarial Networks Framework for the Detection of COVID-19 Pneumonia
summary: federated ResNet with DP-GAN augmentation was evaluated for COVID chest-X-ray classification and reports 94.45% IID accuracy; public class-imbalanced image data do not establish external clinical utility or real-world privacy guarantees.
ai_technology: Federated ResNet plus DP-GAN generation; dataset has 2,000 normal, 1,250 pneumonia, 350 COVID images resized to 28x28.
